params.body:
When a question about a car ("Stel een vraag") could not be sent, the form showed the visitor whatever `/api/lead` answered: the platform's English text (`Vehicle not found.`, `The email field must be a valid email address.`, `Choose at least one contact method (by_phone or by_email).`) or the route's own codes (`upstream_unavailable`, `stocklist_not_configured`, `invalid_json`).

In the last five days 3 of the 6 questions sent through the platform's public lead endpoint were refused, so visitors do see these.

## Changes
- `src/lib/lead-error.ts`: one Dutch sentence per answer, in the site's "u". A car that is gone (404), the field that was refused (422: e-mail, phone, or the contact channel), too many tries (429), anything else. Where the visitor cannot fix it, the sentence gives the phone number.
- `src/pages/api/lead.ts`: a success passes through unchanged; any other answer keeps its status, carries that sentence, and the platform's own answer goes to the function log.
- `test/lead-error.test.ts`: five cases, including that no answer shows the platform's English or a bare code.

## Checks
- `vitest`: 40 tests pass. `astro build` succeeds. `astro check` reports the same 19 errors as `main`, none new.
params.title: A question that cannot be sent says why in Dutch
